artifact: qlab/qlab/events/datafetch/evidence_sources.py — public-information ingestion for the thin-alpha paper-decision track
status: DELIVERED (module + tests). No bulk data committed: evidence is fetched per decision run and persisted by the runner alongside its decision records.
purpose: Supply the `evidence_time` leg of the audit chain `evidence_time <= decision_time <= return_start`. The whole chain is only auditable if evidence_time comes from the INFORMATION SOURCE's own clock, never ours — a self-generated timestamp is self-attestation and proves nothing to 都察院.

hard_contract.rule: A record with no parseable SOURCE timestamp is REJECTED, not stamped with our clock. There is no now()-fallback path anywhere in the module (fail-closed, same discipline as fred_vintage's missing-key behaviour).
hard_contract.two_clocks_kept_separate: source_time_utc = THE audit anchor (from the source). retrieved_utc = OUR clock, labelled, for lag diagnostics ONLY — never used as evidence time.
hard_contract.naive_timestamps_refused: a source timestamp without a timezone offset is rejected rather than guessed (a wrong tz silently shifts an event across the 09:30/16:00 boundary).
hard_contract.validation: validate_records() raises on missing/naive timestamps and on retrieved_utc < source_time_utc (clock skew).

sec_edgar.why: second-resolution UTC time EDGAR actually accepted the filing — NOT the calendar `filingDate`, which cannot tell pre-open from post-close. filing_date/report_date are kept in `extra` for reference only.
sec_edgar.auth: none (free); requires a descriptive User-Agent per SEC policy

feeds_verified_2026_08_08.yahoo_market: same endpoint with s=^GSPC — broad market headlines, 20 items with pubDate
feeds_verified_2026_08_08.globenewswire_public: GlobeNewswire public-company press releases — 20 records, 0 rejected

rss.excluded: prnewswire.com RSS returns HTTP 404 under the SEC User-Agent (works only with a browser UA); deliberately NOT shipped as a default to avoid a UA-fragile source.

fred.note: already delivered and point-in-time aware; FRED_API_KEY persists at ~/.config/fred/api.env (chmod 600, persistent user layer) and is reusable — not re-implemented here.
fred.source_time_semantics: FRED observation `date` is the observation period; the publication/vintage axis is handled by fred_vintage realtime_start/realtime_end. Publication lag (not revision) is the live look-ahead axis — see credit_regime_provenance.json.

live_check_2026_08_08: combined EDGAR + yahoo_symbol + globenewswire pull = 175 records, 0 rejected, validate_records() passed; source_time span 2015-06-10T20:05:10Z .. 2026-08-08T01:30:18Z; lag (retrieved - source) >= 0 for every record, confirming the SOURCE clock was preserved rather than overwritten.
tests: qlab/tests/test_evidence_sources.py (9): EDGAR acceptance-time anchor + rejection of a filing with no acceptance time, form/since filters, RSS pubDate anchor + rejection of missing and naive dates, fail-closed parser, clock-skew detection, parquet round-trip keeping both clocks.
usage_for_the_decision_chain: For each decision: pull evidence, keep source_time_utc as `evidence_time`, and assert evidence_time <= decision_time <= return_start. Rejected records must be logged (they are returned as the second element of every fetch) — a dropped source timestamp is a broken audit link, not a silent skip.
boundary: This module only supplies evidence with trustworthy timestamps. It makes no decisions and produces no verdicts; acceptance stays with research/gate certify().
